offer: Training and clear paths to grow your career
Recognition and rewards for great work

fashion-sales-associate.title: Fashion Sales Associate
fashion-sales-associate.summary: As a Fashion Sales Associate you are the face of Mighty Silks. You will help customers find the perfect saree, lehenga or gown for their special occasions, share styling advice and make every visit to our store a memorable one.
responsibilities: Welcome customers and understand what they are looking for
Recommend pieces, blouses and accessories, and share styling tips
Keep the store, fitting rooms and displays neat and well stocked
Handle billing, alterations requests and returns accurately
Meet individual and store sales goals, especially in festive and wedding seasons
requirements: Experience in fashion or luxury retail preferred
Warm, confident communication in English; Hindi, Malayalam or Arabic a plus
A genuine interest in Indian ethnic wear and fabrics
Flexible to work weekends and festive seasons

visual-merchandiser.title: Visual Merchandiser
visual-merchandiser.summary: As our Visual Merchandiser you will bring our collections to life. From window displays to in-store styling and seasonal campaigns, you will make sure every corner of Mighty Silks tells a beautiful story.
responsibilities: Plan and set up window and in-store displays for each collection and festival
Style mannequins and feature walls to highlight new arrivals and bestsellers
Work with the marketing team on campaign looks and photo shoots
Keep displays fresh, consistent and in line with the brand
requirements: A strong eye for colour, texture and composition
Comfortable with hands-on work, including some evening set-ups

customer-care-executive.title: Customer Care Executive
customer-care-executive.summary: As a Customer Care Executive you will be the friendly voice of Mighty Silks. You will answer questions, track orders and make exchanges and returns easy for our customers by phone, email and chat.
responsibilities: Answer customer questions by phone, email, WhatsApp and live chat
Track orders and keep customers updated on delivery
Handle exchanges, returns and refunds smoothly
Share customer feedback with the store and online teams
requirements: Customer service experience, ideally in e-commerce
Comfortable using order and ticketing systems

social-media-content-executive.title: Social Media & Content Executive
social-media-content-executive.summary: As our Social Media & Content Executive you will tell the Mighty Silks story online. You will plan and create content for our social channels, help run photo shoots and launch new collections to our community.
responsibilities: Plan and post content across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and YouTube
Create photos, reels and short videos for new arrivals and campaigns
Help organise photo shoots and work with models and creators
Reply to comments and messages and grow our community
Report on what works and suggest new ideas
requirements: Experience running fashion or lifestyle social accounts
Up to date with trends across Instagram, Pinterest and YouTube
Good written English with a creative voice
